transient_changes.build_arcs:
def build_arcs(data, excluded, weather):
    windows = coverage(data, excluded)
    if not any(w['status'] == 'RF_COVERED' for w in windows):
        return [], windows
    offset, rate, xyz = calibration_environment(data, excluded, weather)
    rows, arcs = phase_index(data), []
    for w in windows:
        if w['status'] != 'RF_COVERED':
            continue
        start, sites = w['start_gpst_s'], w['rf_available_stations']
        times = [start, start+30, start+60]
        try:
            calibrations = {s: [offset(s, t) for t in times] for s in sites}
            rates = {s: [rate(s, t) for t in times[1:]] for s in sites}
            w['calibration'] = {s: {'offset_statuses': [c['status'] for c in calibrations[s]],
                'rate_statuses': [r['status'] for r in rates[s]]} for s in sites}
            if any(c['status'] != 'CALIBRATION_QUALIFIED' for values in calibrations.values() for c in values) or any(
                    r['status'] != 'ESTIMATED' for values in rates.values() for r in values):
                w['status'] = 'REFERENCE_CALIBRATION_REJECTED'
                continue
            code = np.array([[rows[s][excluded, t]['code_m'] for s in sites] for t in times], float)
            clocks = np.array([[calibrations[s][i]['epochs'][0]['clock_m'] for s in sites] for i in range(3)])
            coordinates = np.array([[xyz(s, t) for s in sites] for t in times])
            geometry, ix = rf_geometry(code, clocks, coordinates)
            w['rf_geometry'] = geometry
            if len(ix) < 4:
                w['status'] = 'RF_MASK_UNSUPPORTED' if geometry['status'] == 'RF_MASK_EVALUATED' else geometry['status']
                continue
            names = [sites[i] for i in ix]
            phase = np.array([[rows[s][excluded, t]['phase_m'] for s in names] for t in times], float)
            means = np.array([[calibrations[s][-1]['epochs'][0]['clock_m'],
                (rates[s][0]['rate_m_s']+rates[s][1]['rate_m_s'])/2.,
                (rates[s][0]['rate_m_s']-rates[s][1]['rate_m_s'])/2.] for s in names])
            arcs.append({'stations': names, 'endpoint_gpst_s': start+60, 'tags_s': interval.shared.TAGS,
                'stations_m': coordinates[-1, ix], 'codes_m': code[:, ix], 'rates_m_s': np.diff(phase, axis=0)/30.,
                'clock_mean': means, 'receiver_clock_basis': interval.clock_basis(interval.shared.TAGS),
                'satellite_clock_count': 3, 'covariance': interval.joint_covariance(len(names), SCENARIO),
                'calibration_statuses': [interval.shared.CALIBRATION]*len(names),
                'propagation': interval.shared.propagation_model(weather, names)})
            w.update(status='PREPARED', stations=names)
        except (ValueError, KeyError, np.linalg.LinAlgError) as error:
            w.update(status='PREPARATION_FAILED', reason=str(error))
    return arcs, windows
transient_changes.prepare:
def prepare(arcs, phase):
    if not isinstance(phase,bool):
        raise ValueError('include_phase must be boolean')
    if not arcs or any(len(a['calibration_statuses'])!=len(a['stations']) or
                       any(s not in ACCEPTED_CALIBRATIONS for s in a['calibration_statuses']) for a in arcs):
        raise ValueError('qualified reference calibrations required before target decoding')
    names = sorted(set(s for a in arcs for s in a['stations']))
    if len(names)<4:
        raise ValueError('at least four distinct stations required')
    basis = helmert(len(names),full=False).T
    prepared,keys = [],set()
    for a in arcs:
        tags,xyz,clocks,codes = [np.asarray(a[k],float) for k in ['tags_s','stations_m','clock_mean','codes_m']]
        n = len(a['stations'])
        ns = a.get('satellite_clock_count',2)
        nc = clocks.shape[1] if clocks.ndim==2 else 0
        clock_basis = np.asarray(a.get('receiver_clock_basis',np.column_stack([np.ones(len(tags)),tags])),float)
        if (not np.isfinite(a['endpoint_gpst_s']) or tags.ndim!=1 or len(tags)<3 or tags[-1]!=0 or np.any(np.diff(tags)<=0)
                or len(set(a['stations']))!=n or n<4 or xyz.shape!=(n,3) or nc not in (2,3) or clocks.shape!=(n,nc)
                or ns not in (2,3) or clock_basis.shape!=(len(tags),nc) or not np.isfinite(clock_basis).all()
                or not np.array_equal(clock_basis[:,:2],np.column_stack([np.ones(len(tags)),tags]))
                or nc==3 and ('receiver_clock_basis' not in a or clock_basis[-1,2]!=0)
                or codes.shape!=(len(tags),n) or len(a['calibration_statuses'])!=n
                or not all(np.isfinite(x).all() for x in [tags,xyz,clocks,codes])):
            raise ValueError('complete finite dynamic RF arc required')
        own = {(s,float(a['endpoint_gpst_s']+t)) for s in a['stations'] for t in tags}
        if keys & own:
            raise ValueError('training arcs reuse target endpoint observations')
        keys |= own
        difference = interval_matrix(tags,n)
        rates = np.asarray(a['rates_m_s'],float) if phase else np.empty((0,n))
        if phase and (rates.shape!=(len(tags)-1,n) or not np.isfinite(rates).all()):
            raise ValueError('finite interval phase rates required')
        observed = np.r_[codes.ravel(),rates.ravel(),clocks.ravel(),np.zeros(3*n)]
        chol = cholesky_covariance(a['covariance'],len(observed))
        local_scale = np.r_[[1e5,10.,.1][:ns],np.tile([1000.,1.,1.][:nc],n),np.full(3*n,1e5)]
        prepared.append({**a,'tags':tags,'xyz':xyz,'clocks':clocks,'codes':codes,'observed':observed,
            'chol':chol,'difference':difference,'local_scale':local_scale,
            'basis':basis[[names.index(s) for s in a['stations']]],'n':n,'phase':phase,
            'ns':ns,'nc':nc,'clock_basis':clock_basis})
    prepared.sort(key=lambda a:a['endpoint_gpst_s'])
    return prepared,names,basis
transient_changes.algebraic_seeds:
def algebraic_seeds(z, stations):
    scale = 1e7
    y, s = np.asarray(z) / scale, np.asarray(stations) / scale
    def matrix(indices):
        yy, ss = y[indices], s[indices]
        a = np.column_stack((2 * (ss[1:] - ss[0]), -2 * (yy[1:] - yy[0])))
        rhs = (ss[1:]**2).sum(axis=1) - (ss[0]**2).sum() - (yy[1:]**2 - yy[0]**2)
        return a, rhs, yy, ss
    a, rhs, _, _ = matrix(list(range(len(y))))
    if len(y)<4 or np.linalg.matrix_rank(a) != (3 if len(y)==4 else 4):
        raise ScientificRejection("multi-root algebraic matrix is rank deficient")
    seeds = [] if len(y)==4 else [np.linalg.lstsq(a, rhs, rcond=None)[0] * scale]
    for indices in combinations(range(len(y)), 4):
        a, rhs, yy, ss = matrix(list(indices))
        if np.linalg.matrix_rank(a) != 3:
            continue
        q = np.linalg.lstsq(a, rhs, rcond=None)[0]
        _, _, vh = np.linalg.svd(a)
        n = vh[-1]
        dx, b = q[:3] - ss[0], yy[0] - q[3]
        coefficients = [n[3]**2 - n[:3] @ n[:3], -2 * (b * n[3] + dx @ n[:3]), b*b - dx @ dx]
        for root in np.roots(coefficients):
            if abs(root.imag) < 1e-8:
                candidate = q + root.real * n
                if np.all(yy - candidate[3] > 0):
                    seeds.append(candidate * scale)
    return seeds
